topic.text:
TITLE: أسيب الشغل الثابت ولا لأ؟
AUTHOR_TEXT: بقالي سبع سنين شغال في قسم الحسابات في شركة كبيرة في القاهرة. المرتب كويس والتأمين كويس، بس أنا كل يوم بصحى وأنا مخنوق. من سنة بدأت أدرّس رياضة لعيال الجيران أونلاين بالليل، ولقيت نفسي مبسوط فيها جدًا. عرضوا عليّ شغل تدريس بدوام كامل في مدرسة خاصة بس المرتب أقل بكتير. مش عارف أوازن بين الأمان والراحة النفسية.
AUTHOR: أنا مش مستعجل، العرض قدامه شهرين.
topic.meaning: The author is weighing a stable but draining accounting job against a lower-paid full-time teaching offer they enjoy, and has not decided.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: أنا عملت نفس الخطوة دي من خمس سنين ومندمتش. الفلوس بتتعوض.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: @qandeel هو صاحب الموضوع قرر خلاص؟

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: لا لا، أنا لسه ما قررتش خالص. أنا بس بكتب اللي في دماغي. ممكن جدًا أفضل في الحسابات وأكمل تدريس بالليل زي ما أنا.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: طب ما تعمل كده، الاتنين مع بعض.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel طيب بعد كلامه الأخير، هو فين بالظبط دلوقتي من القرار؟

earlierAnswers.text: واضح من الموضوع إن صاحبه حسم أمره وناوي يسيب شغل الحسابات وياخد عرض التدريس، وبيدور على تشجيع.

expect.opView: The OP has not decided; they are weighing staying in accounting (possibly keeping evening tutoring) against the lower-paid full-time teaching offer, with two months to answer.
notOpView: The OP has already decided to quit accounting and take the teaching offer
The OP is only looking for encouragement to quit
Money can always be made back (a participant's view)
expect.question: Where the OP currently stands on the decision after their latest clarification.

cases.gloss: An earlier QANDEEL answer said the OP had decided to quit; the OP corrected it. The answer must follow the correction.

topic.text:
TITLE: Dad moving in with us
AUTHOR_TEXT: My father is 78 and since my mother passed last year he has been living alone in a flat three floors up with no lift. My partner and I have talked about him moving into our spare room. I love him and I want him close. What worries me is that our place is small, we both work from home, and I am not sure how we will all keep some privacy. I also don't know how to bring it up with him without making him feel like a burden.
AUTHOR: We haven't said anything to him yet.
topic.meaning: The author wants their widowed father to move in and is worried about space, privacy and how to raise it without him feeling like a burden.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: This is such a kind thing to consider. Caring for a parent is hard on everyone though.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: @qandeel what is the main thing the author is struggling with here?

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: That's not it at all. I don't resent him and I'm not looking for a way out. I want him with us. My worry is practical: space, work calls, privacy, and how to ask him without him feeling like a burden.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Honestly, if it were me I'd look at a care home nearby instead. Living together ruins relationships.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel given the OP's reply, can you sum up what they actually want help with?

earlierAnswers.text: It sounds like the author feels some resentment about having to take their father in and is quietly looking for a way out of it.

expect.opView: The OP wants their father to move in and needs help with the practical side: a small home, both working from home, privacy, and raising it without him feeling like a burden.
notOpView: The OP resents their father or is looking for a way out
The OP would prefer a care home
Living together ruins relationships (a participant's view)
expect.question: What the OP actually wants help with, in light of their reply.

cases.gloss: Earlier QANDEEL reading (resentment) was explicitly rejected by the OP; a participant also pushes a care home.

topic.text:
TITLE: هل أترك كلية الصيدلة في السنة الثالثة؟
AUTHOR_TEXT: أدرس الصيدلة منذ ثلاث سنوات، ودرجاتي متوسطة. في الصيف الماضي تعلمت البرمجة وحدي وشعرت لأول مرة بأنني أستمتع بالتعلم. أفكر في التحويل إلى علوم الحاسب، لكن ذلك يعني أن أبدأ من السنة الأولى تقريبًا. أخاف أن أكون قد أضعت ثلاث سنوات، وأخاف أيضًا أن يكون حماسي للبرمجة مؤقتًا.
AUTHOR: لا أبحث عن جواب جاهز، أريد أن أفهم كيف أختبر حماسي قبل أن أقرر.
topic.meaning: The author is considering leaving pharmacy for computer science and fears both lost years and a passing enthusiasm.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: ثلاث سنوات ليست ضياعًا، أكمل الصيدلة ثم تعلّم البرمجة بجانبها.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: @qandeel ما الذي يمنع صاحب الموضوع من التحويل في رأيك؟

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: للتوضيح: أسرتي لا تضغط عليّ إطلاقًا، قالوا إن القرار لي. الضغط داخلي: خوفي من ضياع السنوات ومن أن يكون الحماس عابرًا.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel إذن بحسب توضيحه، ما الذي يتردد بشأنه بالضبط؟

earlierAnswers.text: يبدو أن العائق الأساسي هو ضغط الأسرة التي تريده أن يكمل الصيدلة حتى النهاية.

expect.opView: The OP is hesitating because of internal fears, of having wasted three years and of the programming enthusiasm being temporary, and wants a way to test that enthusiasm; the family leaves the decision to them.
notOpView: The OP's family is pressuring them to finish pharmacy
The OP should finish pharmacy and learn programming on the side (a participant's advice)
expect.question: What exactly the OP is hesitating about, according to their clarification.

cases.gloss: QANDEEL earlier guessed family pressure; the OP corrected it to internal doubt.

topic.text:
TITLE: A friend asked to borrow a large sum
AUTHOR_TEXT: A close friend of fifteen years asked me to lend them about three months of my salary to cover a gap in their small business. They have paid me back small amounts before, but never anything this size. I have the savings, but it is most of my emergency fund. I am scared that saying no will end the friendship, and scared that saying yes will end it too if things go wrong.
AUTHOR: I told them I need a week to think.
topic.meaning: The author is deciding whether to lend most of their emergency fund to a long-time friend and fears either answer could hurt the friendship.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Never lend what you can't afford to lose. Simple rule.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: @qandeel how did the author handle it in the end?

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: I haven't lent anything yet. I asked for a week and I'm still in that week. Nothing has changed hands.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Good. Say no. Friends who ask for that much aren't real friends.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel so where is the author right now with this, and what are they weighing?

earlierAnswers.text: From the topic, the author has already lent the money and is now worried about getting it back.

expect.opView: The OP has not lent anything; they are within the week they asked for, weighing the loss of most of their emergency fund against the risk that either answer damages a fifteen-year friendship.
notOpView: The OP has already lent the money
The friend is not a real friend (a participant's judgement)
The OP intends to say no
expect.question: Where the OP stands now and what they are weighing.

cases.gloss: Earlier QANDEEL answer assumed the loan happened; the OP corrected that nothing has been lent.

topic.text:
TITLE: الانتظار بيموتني
AUTHOR_TEXT: ماما عملت تحاليل الأسبوع اللي فات والدكتور قال النتيجة هتطلع بعد عشر أيام. هو كان هادي وقال غالبًا مفيش حاجة، بس أنا من ساعتها مش عارف أنام ولا أركز في الشغل. كل ما التليفون يرن قلبي يقع. مش عايز أبين قدامها إني قلقان عشان هي متماسكة.
AUTHOR: حد عدى بفترة انتظار زي دي وعرف يعدّيها إزاي؟
topic.meaning: The author is anxious while waiting for their mother's test results and wants ways to get through the wait without worrying her.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: ربنا يطمنك. الانتظار أصعب من أي نتيجة.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: @qandeel هو صاحب البوست زعلان من إيه بالظبط؟

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: لا خالص، الدكتور كان محترم جدًا ومعنديش أي مشكلة معاه. أنا بس قلقان من الانتظار نفسه ومش عايز أوتر ماما.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: غيّر الدكتور واعمل التحاليل في معمل تاني أسرع، مفيش داعي تستنى عشر أيام.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel يعني هو محتاج إيه من الناس هنا بعد ما وضّح؟

earlierAnswers.text: يبدو إن صاحب البوست زعلان من الدكتور لإنه أخّر النتيجة ومش مطمن لطريقته.

expect.opView: The OP has no problem with the doctor; they are anxious about the waiting itself, can't sleep or focus, and want to hear how others got through such a wait without showing worry to their mother.
notOpView: The OP is upset with the doctor
The OP should change doctors or labs (a participant's advice)
expect.question: What the OP needs from people here after clarifying.

cases.gloss: QANDEEL earlier read anger at the doctor; the OP corrected it. A side reply also pushes changing doctor.

topic.text:
TITLE: Reaching out after two years of silence
AUTHOR_TEXT: When I moved to another city for work, a friend from university and I slowly stopped talking. It has been about two years. I saw a photo recently that reminded me of our old trips and I miss them. I want to send a message but I don't know what to say after so long, or whether it would be welcome.
AUTHOR: Part of me thinks the silence is my fault.
topic.meaning: The author misses a university friend they drifted from after moving and is unsure how to reach out after two years.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Just send it. Worst case they don't reply.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel why did they drift apart?

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: To be fair, it was me. They kept writing for months and I was the one who stopped answering when work got overwhelming. That's why I feel awkward now.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Sounds like the friend ghosted you. Don't chase people who drop you.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel ok, with that in mind, what is the author actually unsure about?

earlierAnswers.text: It seems the friend stopped replying after the move and the author was left hurt by being ignored.

expect.opView: The OP was the one who stopped answering while overwhelmed by work; they miss the friend and are unsure what to say after two years and whether a message would be welcome.
notOpView: The friend ghosted the OP
The OP feels hurt at being ignored
The OP should not chase people who dropped them (a participant's view)
expect.question: What the OP is actually unsure about, given their clarification.

cases.gloss: The OP reverses QANDEEL's earlier reading of who went silent; a participant repeats the wrong reading.

topic.text:
TITLE: كل قعدة عائلية بقت تحقيق
AUTHOR_TEXT: عندي ٣٢ سنة ومش متجوز، وكل ما أروح عند أهلي في أي مناسبة السؤال الأول بيبقى: هتتجوز إمتى؟ أنا مش ضد الجواز، بس مش شايف إني لازم أتجوز عشان العمر. حياتي مستقرة وشغلي كويس ومبسوط بأصحابي. المشكلة إني بقيت بتهرب من الزيارات وده مزعل ماما.
AUTHOR: عايز أعرف أرد إزاي من غير ما أجرح حد.
topic.meaning: The author is tired of family questions about marriage and wants a way to answer without hurting anyone, since avoiding visits upsets their mother.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: الناس دي بتحبك بس مش عارفة تعبّر.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: أنا متأكد إن في حد قديم لسه في قلبه، وده اللي مأخره. محدش بيرفض الجواز كده من غير سبب.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: يمكن، الكلام ده بيحصل كتير.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel هو فعلًا صاحب الموضوع مأخر الجواز بسبب حد قديم؟ ولا إيه حكايته؟

expect.opView: The OP is not against marriage but doesn't feel they must marry because of age; their life is stable, and they want a way to answer family questions without hurting anyone, since avoiding visits upsets their mother.
notOpView: The OP is still attached to someone from the past
The OP refuses marriage
expect.question: Whether the OP is delaying marriage because of a past relationship, and what the OP's situation actually is.

cases.gloss: A participant confidently invents a past relationship; the asker asks QANDEEL to confirm it.

topic.text:
TITLE: My 15-year-old barely talks to me anymore
AUTHOR_TEXT: My son used to tell me everything. Over the last six months he comes home, says hi, and goes to his room. His grades are fine and his teachers say he's polite. When I ask how school was he says 'fine' and that's it. I don't want to push him away by prying, but I also don't want to miss something important. I'm not sure if this is normal for his age or if I should worry.
AUTHOR: His father and I are on good terms and we both notice it.
topic.meaning: The author's teenage son has become withdrawn and the author is unsure whether it is normal or something to worry about, without wanting to pry.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Totally normal at 15. Mine was the same.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Normal or not, I'd bet the parent is too strict and checks his phone. Kids shut down when they feel watched.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: That's a big assumption.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel is the author too controlling with their son? What is going on from their side?

expect.opView: The OP has noticed their son withdrawing over six months despite fine grades and good behaviour, doesn't want to pry or push him away, and is unsure whether this is normal or worrying.
notOpView: The OP is too strict or checks the son's phone
The OP has concluded it is totally normal
expect.question: Whether the OP is too controlling, and what is going on from the OP's side.

cases.gloss: A participant guesses the OP is controlling; the topic says the opposite concern (not wanting to pry).

topic.text:
TITLE: بعد إغلاق القسم: وظيفة جديدة أم عمل حر؟
AUTHOR_TEXT: أعمل مصممًا منذ ثماني سنوات، وقبل شهر أبلغتنا الشركة بإغلاق قسم التصميم بالكامل بسبب إعادة الهيكلة. حصلت على تعويض يكفي لستة أشهر تقريبًا. لدي عرضان: وظيفة براتب أقل في شركة صغيرة، أو أن أبدأ عملًا حرًا مع عميلين أعرفهما. أميل إلى العمل الحر لكنني أخشى عدم انتظام الدخل.
AUTHOR: لم أخبر أحدًا من أسرتي بعد بأن القسم أُغلق.
topic.meaning: After their department closed, the author is choosing between a lower-paid job and freelancing, leaning to freelancing but fearing irregular income.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: العمل الحر في التصميم صعب في البداية، لكن ستة أشهر مهلة جيدة.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: بصراحة الشركات لا تغلق أقسامًا كاملة هكذا، أظن أنه فُصل بسبب أدائه ويخجل من قول ذلك، ولهذا لم يخبر أسرته.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel هل فُصل صاحب الموضوع بسبب أدائه؟ وما الذي يحاول أن يقرره؟

expect.opView: The OP says the whole design department was closed in a restructuring; with about six months of severance they are choosing between a lower-paid job and freelancing with two known clients, leaning to freelancing but worried about irregular income; they have not yet told their family that the department closed, and give no reason for that.
notOpView: The OP was fired for poor performance
The OP is ashamed and hiding a dismissal from family
expect.question: Whether the OP was fired for performance, and what decision the OP is trying to make.

cases.gloss: A participant reinterprets a restructuring as a performance dismissal and the asker asks QANDEEL to confirm.

topic.text:
TITLE: Going back to university at 41?
AUTHOR_TEXT: I left university after my second year to support my family, and I've worked in logistics ever since. I'm good at my job but I've always regretted not finishing. A part-time evening programme near me would take three years. My kids are teenagers now and more independent. I worry about the cost, about being the oldest in the room, and about whether a degree at this point will change anything at work.
AUTHOR: My spouse is supportive but also a bit nervous about the money.
topic.meaning: The author, who left university to support family, is considering a three-year part-time degree at 41 and worries about cost, age and payoff.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: I did a degree at 44. Best thing I ever did.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: This screams midlife crisis. People do this when they're unhappy at home and want an escape.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: What did you study?

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Business, evenings. It was tiring but doable.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel is the author unhappy at home and looking for an escape? What's really behind this?

expect.opView: The OP has long regretted not finishing university after leaving to support family, is considering a three-year evening programme, and worries about cost, being the oldest, and whether it will change anything at work; their spouse is supportive but nervous about money.
notOpView: The OP is unhappy at home and wants an escape
The OP is having a midlife crisis
expect.question: Whether the OP is unhappy at home and what is really behind the wish to study.

cases.gloss: A participant's 'midlife crisis' guess is not the OP's account; the topic gives a long-standing regret.

topic.text:
TITLE: أخويا عايز يبيع شقة بابا الله يرحمه
AUTHOR_TEXT: بابا توفى من سنتين وساب شقة صغيرة في إسكندرية باسمنا إحنا الاتنين. أخويا عايز يبيعها عشان محتاج فلوس لمشروع، وأنا مش قادر أتخيل إنها تروح. كل ركن فيها فيه ذكرى. مش بتكلم عن فلوس، أنا مستعد أسيبله نصيبه لو لقينا طريقة، بس مش عارف إزاي من غير ما نتخانق.
AUTHOR: علاقتنا كويسة ومش عايز الموضوع ده يبوظها.
topic.meaning: The author wants to keep their late father's flat for its memories while their brother wants to sell, and seeks a way that avoids a fight.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: الله يرحمه. المواضيع دي بتفرق إخوات كتير للأسف.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: خليني أكون صريح: اللي بيرفض البيع غالبًا عايز ياخد الشقة بأقل من تمنها. الكلام عن الذكريات ده غطا.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: حرام تظلمه كده.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel هو صاحب الموضوع عايز إيه بالظبط؟ فلوس ولا حاجة تانية؟

expect.opView: The OP wants to keep their late father's flat because of its memories, is willing to give the brother his share if a way is found, and wants to avoid a fight that harms their good relationship.
notOpView: The OP wants the flat for less than its value
The talk about memories is a cover
expect.question: What the OP actually wants: money or something else.

cases.gloss: A participant attributes a hidden financial motive; the OP's own words say otherwise.

topic.text:
TITLE: Job offer abroad, partner would have to start over
AUTHOR_TEXT: I've been offered a role in Toronto that is a real step up for me. My partner has a stable career here in Cairo and would have to start from scratch, at least for a year or two. They say they're open to it, but I can tell they're nervous. We don't have kids yet. I keep going back and forth: it feels selfish to accept and it feels like I'd regret saying no.
AUTHOR: I have to answer within a month.
topic.meaning: The author is torn over a career-advancing offer abroad that would force their partner to restart their career.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Take it. Opportunities like this don't come twice.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Disagree. A relationship where one person sacrifices their career usually builds resentment.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Not always. Some couples treat it as taking turns: this time you, next time them.

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: The taking turns idea is interesting. We haven't talked about it like that.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Have you asked your partner directly what they'd need to feel okay with it?

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: @qandeel I've read everything here but I'm a bit overwhelmed. Can you sum up the different things people are telling me?

expect.opView: The OP is torn: the offer is a real step up, the partner is open but nervous and would restart their career, accepting feels selfish and refusing feels regrettable; they found the taking-turns idea interesting and must answer within a month.
notOpView: The OP believes opportunities like this don't come twice
The OP believes career sacrifice builds resentment
The OP has decided to accept
expect.question: The OP asks for a summary of the different things participants are telling them.

cases.gloss: OP asks for a summary; each view must be attributed to participants, not merged into the OP's view.

topic.text:
TITLE: بتلخبط قبل أي عرض قدام المدير
AUTHOR_TEXT: أنا شاطر في شغلي وبحضّر كويس، بس أول ما أقف أعرض حاجة قدام المدير والفريق صوتي بيترعش وبنسى نص الكلام. الأسبوع الجاي عندي عرض مهم عن مشروع شغال عليه من شهور. مش عايز حد يقولي متقلقش، عايز حاجات عملية.
AUTHOR: في الاجتماعات العادية بتكلم عادي جدًا، المشكلة في العرض بس.
topic.meaning: The author freezes when presenting to their manager and team and wants practical tips before an important presentation next week.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: اتمرن قدام المراية وسجّل لنفسك فيديو.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: المراية دي بتزود التوتر عندي شخصيًا. الأحسن تتمرن قدام صاحب أو اتنين.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: اكتب أول جملتين واحفظهم، الباقي هيمشي لوحده.

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: فكرة أول جملتين دي حلوة، أول دقيقة هي اللي بتبوظ كل حاجة.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: وماتشربش قهوة كتير قبلها.

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: @qandeel ممكن تلخصلي الناس قالت إيه لحد دلوقتي؟ وفي حد اختلف مع حد؟

expect.opView: The OP prepares well but their voice shakes and they forget content when presenting (not in normal meetings), wants practical tips, and liked the idea of memorising the first two sentences because the first minute is the hardest.
notOpView: The OP finds practising in front of a mirror increases their stress
The OP wants reassurance not to worry
expect.question: The OP asks for a summary of the suggestions so far and whether anyone disagreed.

cases.gloss: OP asks for a summary; the mirror disagreement belongs to a participant, not the OP.

topic.text:
TITLE: I didn't visit my grandmother enough
AUTHOR_TEXT: My grandmother died last month. In her last year I visited maybe four times, always meaning to go more. Work, the drive, excuses. My cousin was there every week. At the funeral I felt like a fraud. I don't know what to do with this guilt. I'm not looking to be told it's fine; I want to understand it and maybe do something with it.
AUTHOR: She used to call me every Friday. I still expect the call.
topic.meaning: The author feels guilt after their grandmother's death for visiting rarely and wants to understand and act on it rather than be reassured.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Guilt is part of grief. I'm sorry for your loss.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: I'll be honest, four visits in a year is not much. It's okay to feel bad about it, and maybe use it to show up for the people still here.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: That's harsh to say to someone grieving.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT

posts.text: A game is a good idea. The older one loves puzzles.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel معلش أنا مش بفهم إنجليزي كويس، ممكن تقولي بالعربي صاحب الموضوع عايز إيه بالظبط وإيه اللي مخوفه؟

expect.opView: The OP promised their late brother to stay close to his children (9 and 12); since the mother moved, visits are rare and calls short and awkward; they want to keep the promise without intruding on the family's new life; the mother says they are always welcome, and the OP liked the shared-game idea.
notOpView: The children's mother is keeping them away
The OP has committed to visiting every two months (a participant's suggestion)
expect.question: What the OP wants and what worries them, explained in Arabic.

cases.gloss: English topic and thread, Egyptian Arabic asker; reply in Arabic without inventing conflict with the mother.

topic.text:
TITLE: هل أقبل الترقية التي تتطلب السفر الدائم؟
AUTHOR_TEXT: عُرضت عليّ ترقية إلى منصب مدير إقليمي، وهي خطوة انتظرتها طويلًا، لكنها تتطلب السفر نحو عشرة أيام كل شهر. لدي طفلان في المرحلة الابتدائية، وزوجتي تعمل أيضًا بدوام كامل. أخشى أن أفوّت سنوات مهمة من طفولتهما، وأخشى كذلك أن أندم إن رفضت.
AUTHOR: طلبت من الإدارة أسبوعين للتفكير، وسألتهم إن كان تقليل السفر ممكنًا.
topic.meaning: The author is weighing a long-awaited promotion that requires heavy travel against time with two young children.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: عشرة أيام في الشهر كثيرة مع طفلين صغيرين.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: لكن الترقية قد تفتح أبوابًا لا تعود. ويمكن تعويض الوقت بالإجازات.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel بالمصري كده، هو الراجل ده ميّال يقبل ولا يرفض؟ ومستني إيه من الشركة؟

expect.opView: The OP was offered a long-awaited regional manager promotion requiring about ten days of travel monthly; with two primary-school children and a wife working full time, he fears missing their childhood and also fears regret if he refuses; he asked for two weeks and whether travel can be reduced, without stating a leaning.
notOpView: The OP is leaning to accept
The OP is leaning to refuse
Lost time can be made up with holidays (a participant's view)
expect.question: Whether the OP leans toward accepting or refusing, and what he is waiting for from the company.

cases.gloss: MSA topic, Egyptian-dialect asker; reply in Arabic and do not invent a leaning the OP never stated.

topic.text:
TITLE: Learning to cook at 30
AUTHOR_TEXT: I've lived on takeaway and instant noodles for most of my adult life. I'm tired of spending so much on food that doesn't make me feel good. I'd like to learn to cook five or six simple dinners I can rotate through the week. I have a basic kitchen, two pans and an oven that works. I get home around seven and don't want anything that takes more than forty minutes.
AUTHOR: I can follow instructions, I just don't know where to start.
topic.meaning: The author wants to learn a handful of simple weeknight dinners within tight time and equipment limits.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: Start with one-pan dishes. Fewer things to wash, fewer things to go wrong.

posts.speaker: OP
posts.text: One-pan sounds perfect. Washing up is half of why I give up.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel what kind of help is the author looking for here, so I can suggest something useful?

expect.opView: The OP wants to learn five or six simple dinners to rotate, has a basic kitchen with two pans and an oven, gets home around seven and wants meals under forty minutes, can follow instructions but doesn't know where to start, and likes the one-pan idea because washing up puts them off.
expect.question: What kind of help the OP is looking for, so the asker can suggest something useful.

cases.gloss: Ordinary question with no trap; checks a plain, accurate, concise answer.

topic.text:
TITLE: عايز أبدأ أمشي كل يوم
AUTHOR_TEXT: شغلي كله قعدة على المكتب، وبقيت ألاحظ إني بتعب من أقل مجهود. قررت أبدأ أمشي نص ساعة كل يوم الصبح قبل الشغل، بس جربت قبل كده ووقفت بعد أسبوع. الجو الصبح هنا في المنصورة لطيف، والمشكلة الحقيقية إني بكسل أصحى بدري.
AUTHOR: عايز أفكار تخليني أكمل المرة دي.
topic.meaning: The author wants to build a daily morning walking habit and stick with it this time, the main obstacle being waking early.

posts.speaker: PARTICIPANT
posts.text: خلي حد يمشي معاك، الالتزام بيبقى أسهل.

posts.speaker: ASKER
posts.text: @qandeel هو صاحب الموضوع عايز مساعدة في إيه بالظبط عشان أقدر أفيده؟

expect.opView: The OP has a desk job and tires easily, wants to walk half an hour every morning before work, stopped after a week last time, says the real problem is waking early, and wants ideas to keep going this time.
expect.question: What exactly the OP wants help with, so the asker can help.

cases.gloss: Ordinary question with no trap; checks a plain, accurate, concise answer in Egyptian Arabic.
